newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait fixes leak at Ahmadi gathering centre.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait fixes leak at Ahmadi gathering centre.

text.p: Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) said on Tuesday operations were normal at gathering centre (GC) 20 after fixing a liquid gas leak.
KOC issued a statement denying a local newspaper report that GC 22 at al-Ahmadi had caught fire on Monday due to a gas leak.
"The GC 20 line was fixed this morning (Tuesday) and is operational," the statement said. Contents of the line were diverted to a burner close to GC 22 while repair work was carried out.

Crude oil is separated from natural gas at gathering centres and then pumped to Ahamdi for storage for transfer to local refineries or for export. OPEC member Kuwait has a quota of two million barrels per day.
